title: Regarding James Pearce Jr., Rickea Jackson told court she was "in fear of my life"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Regarding James Pearce Jr., Rickea Jackson told court she was "in fear of my life"
sources.description: In a petition filed following the February 7 incident during which Falcons edge rusher James Pearce Jr. allegedly rammed her car repeatedly, WNBA player Rickea Jackson told a court that she was "in fear of my life," according to ESPN.
